source: HttpWebSocketResponseActionHandler.writeWebSocketFrame's listener when a wss client sends a corrupt TLS record while a scripted message is being written: SslHandler.handleUnwrapThrowable (Netty 4.2.19) fails the read and closes the channel, which fails the written message with StacklessClosedChannelException, so the entry is the DEBUG `client left before WebSocket message {} was sent:{}for request:{}`, never the WARN `async write failure`; the read failure itself is the WARN `web socket server caught SSL or decoder fault`

steps.note: a 42 MB text message over wss to a client that reads its first 4 KiB, then writes an application-data record that does not decrypt, and stops reading

tcp.text:
GET /ws HTTP/1.1
Host: {{host}}
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13

steps.note: the read failure, then the DEBUG entry for message 1 (no `sent WebSocket message` entry)
